typed_core.name: document_type
typed_core.why: ID-8 — establishes status (Permanent Resident Card vs Conditional); the residency the rule tests

typed_core.name: full_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose card; match to the borrower

typed_core.name: date_of_birth
typed_core.why: PII + identity disambiguator — distinguishes same-name borrowers

typed_core.name: uscis_number_or_a_number
typed_core.prompt_hint: The A-number and USCIS number are the same value under different labels — treat as one field

typed_core.name: category_code
typed_core.why: ID-8 — the immigrant category drives program restrictions (e.g. conditional vs unconditional)
typed_core.prompt_hint: CR-prefixed codes = conditional permanent resident (2-year card) — flag for ID-8; a card expiring within the loan window needs updated immigration docs

typed_core.name: sex
typed_core.why: processor — identity match against other documents

typed_core.name: card_expiration_date
typed_core.why: ID-8 — whether the card is valid through closing (short expiry → request updated docs)

typed_core.name: card_issue_or_revision_date
typed_core.why: disambiguator for card version — which I-551 series/rules apply

typed_core.name: signature_or_signature_waived
typed_core.why: processor — authenticity indicator; 'signature waived' is common on minors' cards

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: the I-551 designation is captured by document_type/version; not a filled-form schema

rejected.name: document_issue_date, effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: duplicate card_issue/expiration dates; a card is not a statement

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: single holder covered by full_name; no address on the card

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: not an executed/notarized document; signature_or_signature_waived covers the one indicator

rejected.name: machine_readable_data
rejected.reason: unmasked PII duplicate — the MRZ re-encodes name/DOB/A-number already typed; storing it raw leaks PII to the catch-all

encoding_variations: A-number vs USCIS number — the same 7–9 digit number is labeled 'A#', 'USCIS#', or 'Alien Registration Number'; treat as one field
category_code — codes like IR1, CR1, IR6, E11; CR prefixes denote conditional residents (2-year card) — material to ID-8
resident-since — 'Resident Since', 'Permanent Resident Since'; a date, not a period
card version — legacy I-551 ('Resident Alien' wording) vs current 'Permanent Resident Card'; document_type + card_issue_or_revision_date disambiguate
signature — printed signature vs 'Signature Waived' (minors); degrade the enum to str

open_questions.q: A-number masking policy — register uscis_number_or_a_number raw (snapshot masks) or have the extractor pre-mask to last-3?
open_questions.recommendation: register raw (pre_masked false), consistent with recipient_tin; snapshot handles masking + match-hash GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: Conditional-resident detection — ID-8 cares whether the card is conditional (CR category, 2-year validity)
open_questions.recommendation: (a) derive downstream from category_code + card_expiration_date GEET'S DECISION (LP-439): derive conditional-resident downstream from category_code + card_expiration_date.

open_questions.q: Machine-readable zone — rejected here to avoid unmasked PII
options: if a future authenticity rule needs the MRZ checksum, model it as a nested record with its own redactor
open_questions.recommendation: reject now; if needed later, a nested record with its own redactor, not a catch-all string

notes: 14 typed-core rows — below the 20–25 target, appropriate for a single-rule ID card with a compact field set; every field serves ID-8, identity, PII, or authenticity.

The card is USCIS Form I-551 ('Green Card'); read the front for name/A#/category/dates and the back MRZ only to corroborate. Do NOT emit the full MRZ into the catch-all — it encodes name, DOB, and A-number unmasked.
full_name, country_of_birth, sex are standard-sensitivity identity fields, not registry PII.
